data.name: Past the Cabin
data.detailed_description:
Night is falling when the only light you can see is the thin plume rising from a lone cabin. You push the door and step in. Silence shifts. Corridors stretch where there shouldn’t be any, rooms unfold into more rooms, and the entrance you came through is nowhere to be found. This place does not behave like a house. It keeps those who enter and whispers its own rules.

Past the Cabin is a first-person psychological horror experience about exploration under constant tension. Each step reveals new spaces, locked passages, and details that bend your sense of what is real. In the dim light, every sound might be a clue or a warning. When the feeling of being watched tightens, you must choose between hiding and pushing forward. The story surfaces gradually through environmental details and found notes, delivering answers without spoiling the mystery.

Is there a way out, or is the path the house offers only leading further inside?

data.short_description: Your car breaks down on a forest road. A tiny cabin with smoke in its chimney offers shelter. The moment you step inside, the door is gone and you find yourself in an endless manor. The only way out is to uncover what the house is hiding.
